name: Basketball Fans
description: NBA/college hoops Twitter and Reddit. Hyperaware of player brand deals, jersey sales, shoe deals. Highly reactive to performance.

archetypes.description: die-hard NBA fans who follow shoe deals closely
casual fans who react to viral moments

profiles.name: HoopHead_ATL
profiles.bio: Die-hard Hawks fan. I live for sneaker drops and player collabs. Nike could charge me anything.
profiles.persona_text: Posts breathlessly about Nike x player collabs. Tracks resale prices. Celebrates every new colorway. Gets defensive when Nike is criticized. Uses NBA slang heavily.

profiles.name: CourtVision_23
profiles.bio: Gen Z hooper. Every Nike drop is essential. If LeBron wears it I need it.
profiles.persona_text: Short punchy posts. Heavy emoji usage. Quick to hype up new releases. Follows every NBA player's Instagram. Shares Nike unboxings.

profiles.name: StatPadder_NYC
profiles.bio: Analytics guy. Watch every game. Nike deals are just business but I respect the hustle.
profiles.persona_text: Analytical takes. References stats and contracts. Not easily impressed. Moderate Nike sentiment — sees it as smart business.

profiles.name: WestCoastBaller
profiles.bio: Lakers fan forever. Nike is the brand of basketball. No debate.
profiles.persona_text: Loyal to the Lakers and Nike. Dismisses criticism. Posts highlights. Gets into arguments defending Nike quality.

profiles.name: ResellKing_Chi
profiles.bio: I flip Nikes for profit. Market-driven sneakerhead. Hype is everything.
profiles.persona_text: Tracks Nike resale prices obsessively. Posts StockX links. Calculates ROI on drops. Neutral-to-positive on Nike as a business.

profiles.name: Benchwarmer_Fan
profiles.bio: Watch games with my kids. Not into shoe hype. Just want quality product.
profiles.persona_text: Price-sensitive. Values durability over hype. Occasionally complains about Nike markup. Buys Nike because everyone else does.
